not_reachable.what: the real value of a sensitive field
not_reachable.why: Mavs replaces the real value with a granularly similar synthetic stand-in before the prompt reaches the model; the model keeps the context, the real data never leaves (https://mavsai.ai/llms.txt, read 2026-09-09)

tools.tool: Mavs runtime layer, in the path

grant.note: what you paste or attach is the prompt
the prompt leaves for the model provider with or without Mavs; a gateway changes what is in it, not whether it goes

grant.control: Mavs detects prompt injection attempts, jailbreaks and policy violations at runtime and enforces the customer's policy
grant.note: detected and policed above the prompt; whether an undetected instruction still reaches the model is a question for Mavs (https://mavsai.ai/llms.txt, read 2026-09-09)
